summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian IP development company, filed a Form 6-K containing a press release correcting the day of the week for its OTC Markets trading start date. The release clarifies that shares will begin trading on OTC Markets on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, following an earlier announcement of the company's delisting from NASDAQ. The company has applied for OTCQX Best Market quotation, with an initial tier quotation expected until the application is determined. The TSX Venture Exchange listing remains unaffected. Shareholders need not take action. The correction changes only the day-of-week error; all other details from the August 28 release remain accurate. Watch for confirmation of the OTCQX admission and new U.S. trading symbol.
